_help: Config for the team media drop landing page (media-drop.html). Paste the Google Drive folder URL below so team members can upload photos/videos directly. Admins: when setting up the folder for the first time, create a new Google Drive folder, right-click it, choose 'Share', set 'General access' to 'Anyone with the link' with 'Editor' permission so teammates can upload without a Google login barrier, then copy the share URL into uploadUrl below. See admin-help.html for the full walkthrough.
guidelines: Photos: any resolution is fine — we'll resize before publishing.
Videos: MP4 preferred, keep under ~100MB each.
Caption help: drop a short note in the filename (e.g. 'fishers-of-men-uw-april-handing-out-bibles.jpg') or include a README.txt in the folder.
Please don't upload anything showing minors without a signed release.
It may take a few days for your media to appear on the site — we review and curate everything before publishing.
